response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.articount, CAST(f.articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures f CROSS JOIN t WHERE f.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each scanfeatures row with a non-null articount is one 'site artifact count', so a site code can appear more than once. Counts are not summed per site.
The overall total is the sum of articount across all scanfeatures rows. The average share is the mean of the per-row shares over non-null counts. A zero total is treated as missing.
Ties at the 10th place are cut arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.

alternatives.interpretation: Aggregate artifact counts per site (sum articount by zoneref) first. Shares and the average share are then computed per site instead of per row.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS articount FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT g.zoneref, g.articount, CAST(g.articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM g CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
